purpose: Canonical rules not yet represented as first-class entries in operator-directives.v1.json or dedicated policies.

rules.requirement: Do not repeat the same search, tool, diagnostic, proof or blocked route when target, SHA/tree, scope, state and evidence have not materially changed; reuse evidence, change strategy or stop at the minimal human boundary. Blind automatic GitHub/Web fallback is forbidden.
STOP is authoritative and never bypassed. STOP state records cause, scope, date, owner and resume condition; reset/resume is distinct, explicit, human and auditable.

Production promotion, destructive retention/purge and other irreversible actions require explicit human authorization bound to exact candidate/revision/scope; authorization never spills into another train or object.
State reporting distinguishes DECIDED, EXECUTED, VERIFIED and ACTIVE; a prompt, plan or authorization alone is never proof of execution or activation.
The Canonical Architecture Index is a derived read-model, never a competing registry. Every request performs architecture preflight/context snapshot; stale or absent CAI blocks blind search.
Central Interface Fast Path is a reversible acceleration only; on digest/policy/capability divergence it falls back to full orchestration and never bypasses governance.
Maintain a governed creation/production channel and a lightweight conversational/research channel; conversation must not silently gain production mutation authority.
VPS hosts execution/runtime/cache/active DBs; NAS durable projects/masters/incrementals/backups/artifacts; GitHub code/config; Cloudflare production state/surfaces. Roles must not silently swap.
Storage Governor is mandatory; no deletion before replication verification, durable Master is immutable with incrementals, and active Collector DBs are never moved hot.
ChaChaNas remains passive/fenced durable storage unless separately authorized; single-writer enforced, no active standby and no failover without explicit authorization.
LOCAL_SQLITE is authoritative Sovereign state. D1 is stale fallback only; no automatic D1_REMOTE cutover/failover and Cloudflare Guardian cron remains quiesced unless separately governed.
Native Local/Qwen activation and HA failover are OFF by default and require separate explicit qualification and authorization; shadow proof or roadmap presence never authorizes activation.
ChaCha DEV Adaptive Cognitive Router is routing/decision authority; Qwen/native-local, LiteLLM, Portkey and other providers/gateways are replaceable execution adapters.

Remote MCP uses allowlisted paths and named parameterized operations with operator identity, append-only audit, leases, read/write/destructive separation, Guardian/Bastion/STOP and zero-cost ceiling; generic shell/argv, secret paths and unauthorized git push are forbidden.
Hardened baseline operations are git_status, git_head, git_tree, service_is_active, service_is_enabled, uptime, free_bytes and uname; expansion requires a separately governed capability contract.
ChaCha proprietary Remote MCP and Remote Desktop Commander are distinct components and must never be conflated in CAI, CCR, cockpit, evidence or routing.

Foundry agents require tests, explicit permissions/budget, versioned Guardian contract, collection bindings, termination policy, learning uplink and provenance; no self-modification/self-promotion; lifecycle QUALIFY -> SHADOW/PILOT -> ADOPT.
Architecture Council recommends/adjudicates admissibility; Central Orchestrator decides/dispatches governed execution; agents/adapters do not silently acquire central decision authority.
Last War access is strictly READ_ONLY; Collector mutations are limited to internal discovery/proof/terminalization bookkeeping and may never mutate game state.
Already-qualified seeds/servers are excluded before Seed Scout and never rescanned; persistent ledger/resume is authoritative for prior qualification state.
After three attempts without data, mark SEED_SKIPPED_NO_DATA, preserve valid evidence, do not count the seed as qualified, and continue Autopilot.

A Consultant may converse/build only within own isolated guest projects; Core/agents/infrastructure internals, central memory, Technology Watch and global surfaces are not exposed; platform mutation forbidden; jobs/sessions/artifacts isolated.
